headline: National Queue Registry Disbanded After Years of Honorable Inactivity
deck: Former federal body closes its doors, leaving the nation to ponder the fate of brass stanchions and dignity.
article:
In a ceremony as lively as a tax audit, the National Queue Registry ended operations yesterday after decades of preserving the nation's unused velvet ropes. Staff released a final batch of 1997 deli tickets before locking the warehouse, where yellowed placards still promised service that no one had requested since the Ford administration.

Harold S. Button, the agency's final director, locked the last stanchion and noted that Elbow Priority Permits had made single-file waiting obsolete, shifting every transaction into an open scramble. The farewell ended when a 2023 Melee Commission ribbon was cut and the remaining copies of the Single-File Formation Clause were scattered across the floor.

Attendees at the Polite Melee Championship now navigate without printed rules, while former registry employees search for new roles in a country that has abandoned numbered tickets.
author: Martha T. Docket, Senior Bureaucratic Affairs Correspondent

oped.title: Disbanding the Registry: A National Shame We Brought on Ourselves with Poor Millinery
oped.author: Lord Percival Twaddle, Honorary Curator of Phantom Barriers at the Museum of Hypothetical Order
oped.body: The registry's closure is a civic catastrophe created by citizens who refused to stand in rows. Wide-brimmed hats made any orderly formation impossible, and now seventeen polished stanchions sit unused in my drawing room. Instead of dissolving the agency, lawmakers should have required my Adjustable Queue Bonnet with built-in rope loops. Without that rule, post offices will stay chaotic and my Saturday errands will remain ruined by hat-wearing crowds. Dignity requires restoring the registry, with me in charge.

classifieds.text: Pristine brass stanchions and retractable belts, 47 units, untouched since the Registry's last memo in 2019. Must sell before my garage becomes a Darwinian free-for-all.

Urgent: Polite melee trainers needed for Six Flags' new 'Survival of the Nicest' queue-free zones. Experience in gentle elbows and 2026 crowd psychology required; pay negotiable amid national dignity shortage.
Desperate M seeks F who won't trample during deli counter scrambles. Registry closure left me adrift; let's revive mutual respect before next theme park opening.
Apology from former Queue Registry clerk: I hoarded dignity for years and now it's all melee. Brass stanchions available for pickup; no lines, obviously.

panels.caption: Clerk: 'Zero queue filings again this quarter.'
Director: 'Pack the forms with the velvet ropes anyway.'
Punchline: The staff stampede the exit without a word.

stories.headline: Stanchion Surplus Auction Draws Record Bidders After Registry Closure
stories.deck: Expired deli-ticket holders pivot to bulk purchases of velvet rope hardware.
stories.article: Federal warehouses emptied 14,000 brass stanchions after the registry closed. Melee Commission permit holders spent crude-trade proceeds on the lots, driving one stanchion to 3.2 expired tickets on the secondary market. Delis have begun using the posts to divide lunch crowds that no longer form lines.

stories.headline: Minor-League Ballparks Test 'Roving Vendor' Rules After Queue Registry Ends
stories.deck: Teams now award extra innings to fans who reach the nacho cart first.
stories.article: Midwest ballparks removed fixed concession windows and sent carts through the stands without marked paths. Attendance rose 22 percent at the Peoria game as spectators converged on the hot-dog vendor each inning. League records show seven extra innings played solely because vendors kept circling without a queue system.

stories.headline: Sunday Services Introduce Rotating Altar Access After Federal Registry Dissolves
stories.deck: Ushers now distribute elbow-priority tokens printed on old collection envelopes.
stories.article: Midwest Synod churches replaced single-file communion lines with simultaneous clusters at each rail. Services shortened by nine minutes as worshippers sorted themselves by height. One Minnesota parish added a second collection pass and recorded a 17 percent increase in donations.

real_world_echo: obliquely mirrors ICC prosecutor removal by framing an institution's quiet decommissioning as punishment for outdated 'misconduct' in a system that no longer exists
